check.r1: 4 of 10 on the registered rule; 8 of 9 within 0.5 m at the mapped flood's edge (no bar)

sensors: Two storm-tide sensors stood in Westerly for Sandy (USGS OFR 2013-1043, Table 3): Watch Hill peaked at 5.86 ft NAVD88 (1.79 m) at 23:52 GMT Oct 29; the Weekapaug Breachway at 6.39 ft (1.95 m) at 00:31 GMT Oct 30. New London, the clock used here, peaked at 1.85 m at 00:00 GMT. None stood at Misquamicut. Their hour-by-hour records were not obtained (the survey's service has moved).
